describes: The environment in which the frozen QRS 2026 data was successfully replayed
is_not: A record of the original experiment environment. Nothing in this file may be copied into ORIGINAL_EXPERIMENT_METADATA.json. The original host environment was never recorded and remains not_recorded there.
dependency_derivation: AST import analysis of the three frozen analysis scripts, not requirements.txt. They import only csv, json, os, collections, itertools from the standard library plus numpy (all three) and scipy (analyze_part2). pandas and matplotlib appear in requirements.txt but are imported by no analysis script, so they are not replay dependencies.

packages_in_requirements_txt_but_unused_.boto3: declared range >=1.34,<2.0; provider SDK, never needed for replay

lock.closure_note: numpy has no runtime dependencies; scipy depends only on numpy, which is pinned. pip download inside the target image produced exactly these two artifacts.
lock.checkov_compatibility: research/requirements-checkov-3.2.517.lock (separate; version-pinned only; off the replay path)

container.registry_digest_note: null by design: the image has not been pushed. A locally built image's RepoDigests value is bound to no registry and must not be recorded as provenance.

host_platform.note: The container run used --platform linux/amd64, so the hash-pinned linux wheels applied. Both host and container produced identical results.

scanner_not_exercised.note: The replay recomputes tables from frozen run records and never invokes Checkov, so the local 3.3.0 installation cannot influence the result. Any workflow that re-executes the scanner must pin 3.2.517.

result.ast_literal_eval_note: Retained as a compatibility path for repr-encoded values. This artifact stores every verification value as a JSON object, so the path is not exercised. An earlier report incorrectly described 759 dictionaries as having been parsed by it.
result.final_verdicts_unavailable_reason: In each, the final verify-loop attempt recorded error 'empty_extraction' and produced no verification object. All three records carry overall_verified_fix = false, consistent with a failed final attempt. They are classified as unavailable evidence, not skipped.
result.canonicalisation_applied: CRLF->LF plus exactly one trailing newline
result.figures_note: No frozen analysis script calls savefig; the three committed PNGs are not reproduced by this replay and are protected by the byte manifest instead.
